comments: Chosen assumptions: agent1 starts 50–65 m ahead in ego’s lane, faces opposite the lane direction, and accelerates straight into an opposing approach. Ego travels in the intended direction using its lane-following controller. Agent1 is the wrong-way initiator; ego is the exposed responder. Speeds are 7–10 m/s for ego and 6–9 m/s initially for agent1; agent1 throttle is 0.15–0.25. Conflict opportunity, without a required collision.
